profile.headline: Systematic Trading Software Engineer
profile.geoLocationName: New York, New York, United States
profile.summary:
Senior software engineer with experience in finance (pricing, trading, risk management, market data, trade processing...).

C# Certification & FRM

positions.title: Systematic Trading Software Engineer (Rates Platform Lead  - Director)
positions.description:
- Fixed Income
- Infrastructure
- Operations
- Research
- Performance
- Software engineering

positions.title: Senior front office developer (Interest Rate Derivatives)
positions.description:
Lead developer on the new US Fixed Income ETF infrastructure (data, pricing, risks and trade processing)

Supporting other fixed incomes activities
- Agency desk
- Latam desk
- Treasury desk
- Inflation desk
- Swap desk

Technical environment:
C#, Excel, WPF, Reuters, Prism, DevExpress, ZeroC based distributed systems, Reuters, Bloomberg

Operational environment:
Trading floor, agile development

Participate into global effort to move away from All-in-one Excel spreadsheets and replace them by WPF/C# GUI with distributed pricing, trading & risk management

Work close to Traders, R&D, IT and operations.

positions.title: Senior front office developer (Exotic Credit Derivatives)
positions.description:
Supporting the US SGCIB Credit platform:
- Structured Credit: risk management, bespoke baskets, structured notes
- Flow: CDS, CDS Indexes, Index tranches, option on indexes, bonds
- Negative basis trading

Technical environment :
C#, WPF, ION, Oracle, SQL Server/Analysis Service, Excel, VBA, Reuters, Bloomberg, XML, SQLite, JIRA, SVN, DevExpress

Operational environment:
Trading floor, agile development

Multiple roles to support the credit business:

[+] Trader assistant: maintain trading systems, risk analysis, pricing/marking, PnL attribution

[+] Rapid application developer : 
- Decommission, migration, enhancement and development of systems/applications (trading/pricing systems, reporting systems, monitoring systems, market data/reference data systems)
- Development of common libraries & reusable components to improve productivity

[+] Project lead/coordination:
- Gather requirements
- Change management
- Communication

[+] R&D:
- Issue recommendations on the information system
- Design specifications
- Create proof of concept & studies (product evaluation, gap analysis...)

Work close to Traders, R&D, IT and operations.

positions.title: C# Developer
positions.description:
Technical environment:
Cruise Control .NET, Nant, MBUnit, C#, XML

- Enhancement of the continuous integration & testing platform
- Development of a database performance metrics (PL SQL /C#)
- Improvement of the scheduling algorithm used to execute the test on the grid platform
- Development of a Winforms based GUI for test results analysis

positions.title: Market Data Manager
positions.description:
Technical environment:
Reuters, Fininfo, Bloomberg, Excel

- Daily valuation (option pricing, market data extraction...) and control (missing prices, mispricing, corporate actions,...)  to ensure the NAV of the funds were correct before market open
- VBA developement for task automation
- Fund administration: respond to manager's inquiries, booking operations

positions.title: Network administrator assistant (Trainee)
positions.description:
- Management of the company's backup operations
- Desktop support for analysts & developers
- Network support
- Built a new server used for email archives storage

projects.title: Operational risk management software for Banque De France
projects.description:
Software evaluating Value at Risk for operational risk management based on historical data or parameters using Loss Distribution Approach, Monte Carlo simulation and Bayesian inference

Developed with C++, GTK+, Open GL, Boost.
